test_shrink_dtype_series: test shrinking a Series to the smallest fitting dtype using Series.shrink_dtype()
test_shrink_dtype_dataframe: test shrinking all columns in a DataFrame using pl.all().shrink_dtype()
test_shrink_dtype_large_integers: test shrinking Int128 and UInt128 Series with very large integer values
test_shrink_dtype_deprecation: test that DataFrame-level shrink_dtype emits a DeprecationWarning suggesting Series.shrink_dtype
test_shrink_dtype_preserve_values: test that shrink_dtype preserves original values while reducing dtype width
